Author: MusicManBowls, kihtli
Name: Hunt Helper Evolved
Punchline: Hunt trains, Discord reports, spawn points and your detection range on the in-game map.
Description: Hunt tracking for FFXIV. Detects marks and records a train with exact kill times, posts Discord reports sorted by the order marks actually died, draws spawn points, your detection range and SS event locations on the in-game map, counts S-rank trigger mobs, and keeps a lifetime per-mark kill tally per character.
